children: Oman's Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (PWP) has invited bids from qualified geothermal consultancy firms for Phases 2 and 3 of its Hot Springs Geothermal Project.

The tender, issued under reference OPWP/2026/042 on Tuesday, covers geological, geochemical and deep geophysical investigations, geothermal resource assessments, three-dimensional (3D) conceptual modelling, site selection and preliminary techno-economic assessments.
The consultancy scope also includes the preparation of a temperature-gradient drilling programme, according to the tender notice.
An optional Phase 3 covers drilling tender support and supervision, post-drilling resource assessment, and detailed feasibility and development studies.
Tender documents will be available for purchase from 13 to 26 October 2026, with bids due by 12 noon Oman time on 30 November 2026.
Bidders are required to submit a tender bond or bank-certified cheque equivalent to at least 1 percent of the tender value, valid for 120 days from the bid submission deadline.
The announcement did not disclose the project's location, proposed generation capacity, investment cost or implementation schedule.

In April 2025, PWP had invited request for proposals (RFPs) from consultants to study the prospects for developing the Hot Springs Geothermal Project. The scope included feasibility assessment of the geothermal energy potential in specific pre-identified locations within the area between Wilayat Fanja and Al Ansab (Wilayat Bousher) in the first phase.
(Writing by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
